summary_markdown: The discussion focused on updating the source data for facility sessions. [p1] inquired about the `created` column in the `facility_virtual` table, confirming it determines the date from which session data is copied. It was determined that this column needs to be updated to `2024-09-27`. [me] confirmed this understanding and stated they would perform the update.
decisions: The `created` column in `facility_virtual` must be updated to reflect the start date of session data (`2024-09-27`).
